components.name: Straight rill channel
components.function: Existing source junction lacks complete detached straight/bend/T/pool interface reference
components.construction: One ivory/rose stone straight rill channel inspired by existing carved channel junction, basin wall thickness and gold edge. Dry solid substrate with open U-channel; transparent turquoise water only an illustrative inset, not a fused solid block. Planar matching inlet/outlet ports and readable underside. Proposed channel opening0.6m wide and0.22m deep.

components.notes: Four groups visible including Tjunction. Ports and open channel shown; water illustration is not solid geometry. End port widths, corner radius and rim height not evaluated meshes. Source backs, dimensions, repeat patterns, inter-view parity and physical attachment remain unverified. Whole-sheet generation does not prove individual meshes are separable.
